Messages.Author: KG...@itg.ti.com
Messages.Body:
In a recent game, my predator played and "Army of Rats" against me. This card
said it could be burned by any minion as a directed action. The question arose
on whether or not the minion attempting to burn the card, needs a directed
action card to do so or can the minion use an attempt to bleed or an incounter
in topor (the only directed actions that do not require cards) to burn the
card?

Patrick Broussard
KG...@itg.ti.com

Messages.Author: bopo
Messages.Body:


The burning of the card is considered a cardless directed action. You
pretty much say, "I'm burning your Army of Rats," and your predator can
attempt to block it.

Messages.Author: Brian Wilson
Messages.Body:



No card is required to attempt to burn any card that says it can be
burned with a directed action. Bleeding is a cardless directed action,
and so is burning a card like Rats Warning.

Also, some cards can be burned by a successful vote, called as a
political action. No card is required for this, either.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
KG...@itg.ti.com writes:



The "card" your minion requires *is* the army of rats card.
Simply announce that your minion is attempting to burn the AoR.
(Sim for Stealing the rack, Removing blood from someone else's
Powerbase: Chicago or Washington D.C., etc.)
